standard.title: JavaScript Package Publication
standard.summary: npm publications preserve upstream package contents and bind tarballs, metadata and source evidence to the exact patched release.
standard.fitness-role: Experimental JavaScript profile; not an approved gate

requirements.override-explanation: Specializes the parent upstream inventory and checksum obligation for npm tarballs, their contents and separately published companion files; no required upstream role is waived.
requirements.text: Producers must retain the exact upstream package inventory and publish a patched tarball preserving its required file roles and entry points, plus counterparts of separately published upstream companion files and required checksums.

checks.override-explanation: Examines the npm tarball contents and companion-file inventory while retaining the parent completeness and checksum obligations.
checks.title: npm publication preserves required upstream file roles and entry points

requirements.text: Published source files must match the patched tag through an explicit path mapping; generated or transformed files must be individually identified with their generating inputs and command, and required source inputs must not be silently omitted.

checks.title: Packaged sources match the patched tag and generated files have declared origins

requirements.text: The registry version metadata must identify the same package name and patched version as the tarball package.json, and its tarball reference and advertised integrity must identify the exact bytes evaluated and promoted.

checks.title: Registry metadata resolves to the evaluated package identity and tarball bytes
